title: Mattermost versions 11.11.x <= 11.11.0, 11.7.x <= 11.7.11, 11.10.x <= 11.10.2 fail to enforce the Access Control…
description: Mattermost versions 11.11.x up to 11.11.0, 11.7.x up to 11.7.11, and 11.10.x up to 11.10.2 have an access control enforcement issue. The flaw allows authenticated channel members who are denied download access to specific files to still obtain metadata and rendered preview thumbnails of those files via certain endpoints and events. This issue affects bulk post retrieval, channel bookmarks, and persistent notification delivery features.
